capitalisation.description: The company's capitalisation once the post-money SAFEs convert, C₀ ÷ (1 − f), shown under RND-DISPLAY to 2 decimals; absent when none converts.

conversions.description: Each recorded SAFE or note that converts at the round, in the order recorded.

post_money_part.description: f: the part of the company the post-money SAFEs convert into, Σ amount ÷ cap, as a percentage shown under RND-DISPLAY to 2 decimals; absent when none converts.

round_id.description: The approved issue for cash it converts at, when one was named.

round_price.description: The round's price per share in the base currency.

shares_before.description: C₀: the shares issued and held at the end of the day before the round (today, for a price typed in).
